transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been hearing voices and seeing things that other people can't see or hear. It has been happening for a while now, and it is getting really overwhelming.
Have you experienced any periods of extreme mood swings, either feeling very high or very low, in addition to the voices and visions you're experiencing?

I don't ever get those "high" or hyperactive feelings, only the very deep lows. For about the past two months, I've felt incredibly sad, empty, and down, all while still dealing with the voices and visions.
Did the voices and visions start before, after, or around the same time as your feelings of sadness and emptiness?
The voices and visions actually started much earlier, about a year and two months ago. The heavy feelings of sadness and emptiness only began recently, about two months ago.
For the majority of the time you've been experiencing voices and visions, about the first year, were you feeling relatively normal in terms of your mood, without significant depressive symptoms?
No, I wouldn't say I felt normal during most of that year. For about six months before this deep sadness hit, I already felt very empty, had no motivation, and

Would you say that even before the past two months of deep sadness, your depressive symptoms, such as feeling empty and having no motivation, were prominent and interfered with your daily life, or were they milder?

Yes, they were definitely prominent and interfered with my life quite a bit. Even before the severe sadness started two months ago, those feelings of emptiness and having no motivation were there for the majority of the time. It
Can you estimate how long you had psychotic symptoms, such as voices and visions, without any significant depressive symptoms, if at all, during the entire course of your illness?

Yes, there was a brief period of about two weeks right at the very beginning where I was hearing and seeing things but didn't feel depressed or empty at all. After those two weeks, the mood issues started to set in.
Do you think the voices and visions have been influencing your mood or are they separate, and have you noticed any times when the voices and visions changed or stopped when your mood changed?

They feel pretty separate, though having them certainly doesn't help my mood. Even during the times when I didn't feel depressed at all, like those first two weeks, the voices and visions were still happening. They don't seem to stop or change when my mood shifts.

Can you tell me more about how the voices and visions have been affecting you during the times when you're feeling your worst in terms of sadness and emptiness, and if there's any pattern to when they're most intense or disturbing?

When my sadness and emptiness are at their worst, the voices and visions feel much more intense and overwhelming. However, they also happen completely on their own; even during times when I don't feel depressed, they can persist for weeks. There isn't really a pattern to them, as they just seem to continue regardless of how my mood changes.

Do the voices and visions ever seem to trigger or worsen your feelings of sadness and emptiness, or do they seem to be more of a constant presence that you've learned to cope with, regardless of your mood state?

The voices and visions definitely make my sadness worse, but they are a constant presence that happens on their own. They persist even during times when my mood is relatively stable and I don't feel actively sad or empty. They just seem to exist completely independently of my emotional state.

It sounds like the voices and visions have a significant impact on your daily life and emotional state. To summarize, you've been experiencing these psychotic symptoms for over a year, with a significant portion of that time also including depressive symptoms, correct?

Yes, that is completely accurate. I have been dealing with the voices and visions for about 1 year and 2 months in total, and for the majority of that time, I've also been struggling with severe depressive symptoms like sadness, emptiness, and extreme fatigue.
